verdict.rationale: AutoGen docs mention the ability to 'Serialize and deserialize components' (state save/load) and separate logging of traces, which are building blocks for checkpointing, but there is no documented crash-recovery or 'resume exactly where it left off' workflow, no example of restoring an in-progress run after a restart, and no independent evidence confirming this works in practice. missing for 10: explicit resume-after-crash example, automatic checkpoint triggers, hands-on/community validation of state restoration.
